chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil, may Allah be pleased with him, told us. He said: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar told us, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Mufaddal ibn Umar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The one who rides a riding animal, then falls from it and dies, will enter the Fire.

key_terms.زَامِلَةً: riding animal or beast of burden

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for someone who dies after falling from a riding animal?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Mani al-Akhbar*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes a specific legal ruling where falling from a riding animal and dying results in entry into the Hellfire. While often interpreted as a sign of divine punishment or a specific state of the soul, Shia scholars contextualize this within the broader framework of *mawt bi-l-khata'* (death by error) or *mawt bi-l-ikhtiyar* (death by choice), distinguishing it from general natural death to highlight the spiritual consequences of one's state at the moment of demise.
